description: This file contains the implementation of HTTP/1.1 protocol handling within the libwebsockets library, including connection management, data reading, writing, role management, and event handling functions. It defines role operations, state transitions, and callback behaviors specific to the HTTP/1.1 role in a websocket and HTTP server/client context.

methods.name: int lws_read_h1(struct lws * wsi,unsigned char * buf,lws_filepos_t len)
methods.description: Reads and processes incoming HTTP/1.1 data, handling headers, body content, WebSocket frames, and state transitions based on the connection's current role and state.

methods.name: int lws_h1_server_socket_service(struct lws * wsi,struct lws_pollfd * pollfd)
methods.description: Handles server-side socket events for HTTP/1.1, including reading data, managing connection states, and processing incoming requests or data fragments.

methods.name: int rops_handle_POLLIN_h1(struct lws_context_per_thread * pt,struct lws * wsi,struct lws_pollfd * pollfd)
methods.description: Handles POLLIN events for HTTP/1.1 role, managing incoming data, parsing, and state transitions, including websocket and HTTP request handling.

methods.name: int rops_handle_POLLOUT_h1(struct lws * wsi)
methods.description: Handles POLLOUT events for HTTP/1.1 role, triggering data writes or protocol-specific actions when writable.

methods.name: int rops_write_role_protocol_h1(struct lws * wsi,unsigned char * buf,size_t len,enum lws_write_protocol * wp)
methods.description: Performs protocol-specific data transformations and issues raw data for HTTP/1.1, including compression handling.

methods.name: int rops_alpn_negotiated_h1(struct lws * wsi,const char * alpn)
methods.description: Handles ALPN (Application-Layer Protocol Negotiation) result for HTTP/1.1, typically setting keepalive based on negotiation.

methods.name: int rops_destroy_role_h1(struct lws * wsi)
methods.description: Cleanup function to detach headers, free resources, and reset state when closing an HTTP/1.1 role connection.

methods.name: int rops_adoption_bind_h1(struct lws * wsi,int type,const char * vh_prot_name)
methods.description: Binds a websocket or HTTP connection to the HTTP/1.1 role, attaching header tables and setting initial state.

methods.name: int rops_client_bind_h1(struct lws * wsi,const struct lws_client_connect_info * i)
methods.description: Client-side role binding for HTTP/1.1, establishing protocol state based on connection info and method.

methods.name: int rops_close_kill_connection_h1(struct lws * wsi,enum lws_close_status reason)
methods.description: Handles connection closure and cleanup for HTTP/1.1 role.

methods.name: int rops_pt_init_destroy_h1(struct lws_context * context,const struct lws_context_creation_info * info,struct lws_context_per_thread * pt,int destroy)
methods.description: Initializes or destroys per-thread context data related to HTTP/1.1, such as scheduling lifecycle checks.
